title: My Family's Jobs
text:
My sister is a doctor. She works at a big hospital in the city. She helps sick people every day. She starts work at eight in the morning.

My brother is a teacher. He teaches English at a school near our house. He likes his students very much. He finishes work at three in the afternoon.

questions.text: What can we guess about my sister's job?
options: It is hard work that helps other people
It is boring and she does not like it
It takes only one hour a day
It is done mostly at home

questions.text: What kind of teacher is my brother most likely?
options: A kind teacher who cares about students
An angry teacher who shouts at students
A teacher who does not like his job
A teacher who works late every night

vocabulary.definition: a building where sick people receive medical care
people who are learning at a school or university

paragraph_translations: Kız kardeşim doktor. Şehirde büyük bir hastanede çalışıyor. Her gün hasta insanlara yardım ediyor. Sabah sekizde işe başlıyor.
Erkek kardeşim öğretmen. Evimizin yakınındaki bir okulda İngilizce öğretiyor. Öğrencilerini çok seviyor. Öğleden sonra üçte işini bitiriyor.
